what: IndexedDB (the store RAWA's offline POS uses) vs a cloud round trip, same device, same minute
device: Windows 11 laptop, 4 logical cores, Chrome (desktop), consumer ISP in Jordan
script: measure/local_vs_cloud.js (first pass, N=300 records, 30 cloud calls)
caveats: The tab was in a background/hidden window during this run; Chrome throttles such tabs, which explains the single 1658 ms read outlier. A second, longer pass froze the tab and was discarded rather than selectively reported.
The cloud call is a trivial uncached endpoint (/api/method/ping) behind a CDN: a real POS call that writes a sale costs at least this much.
